title: THE WHITE CHARGE // BARRISTAN THE BOLD
narrative: The Great Bronze Gate of Meereen groaned open at the first glimmer of dawn. Barristan Selmy sat astride a silver stallion, his white armor polished until it reflected the rising sun like a second blade. 'Here we are, lads!' he cried, raising his sword high. Five thousand freedmen spearmen, pit fighters with spiked knuckles, and brass-armored legionnaires surged forward into the Yunkish trebuchet lines. Barristan sliced through three sellsword officers before his stallion even broke stride, leading the cavalry wedge with the ferocious grace of a man who had won tourneys before the king was born.

options.text: Barristan: Walk in on King Hizdahr's hedonistic pleasure palace in the pyramid.
Victarion: Smash the naval blockade to secure the eastern front.
Daenerys: Rain fire from above upon the fleeing slaver legions.
Barristan: Parley with Victarion to establish the council of war.
